parameterPolicy: Fixed engineering defaults based on the nominal equilibrium; no parameter selection on these evaluation cases. Preview is explicitly disabled in the unannounced-step case. PI is a practical baseline, not an optimally tuned controller.

solver.name: Dense convex QP / SciPy SLSQP with independent KKT checks
solver.model: Analytic nominal hydraulic Jacobian with affine RK2 discretization and causal disturbance estimation
solver.constraints: Hard magnitude and slew limits; soft predicted level bounds with two penalized maximum-excursion slacks. No physical safety guarantee.
solver.failure: Reject unconverged iterates; use bounded, rate-limited PI fallback. This solver does not certify infeasibility; infeasibleSteps is zero, iteration limits count as solverFailures.
